questions.questionText: All elements in HTML5 are organized using:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Tags.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a basic tag in HTML5?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) <head>.

questions.questionText: Tags in HTML are also referred to as:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Markup.

questions.questionText: An HTML element consists of:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Tags, attributes, and content.

questions.questionText: A start tag begins with:
options: An opening angular bracket followed by the element name
questions.correctAnswer: An opening angular bracket followed by the element name
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) An opening angular bracket followed by the element name.

questions.questionText: Attributes are:
options: Name/value pairs that describe the element and its content format
questions.correctAnswer: Name/value pairs that describe the element and its content format
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Name/value pairs that describe the element and its content format.

questions.questionText: An end tag is written exactly as the start tag except that it includes a:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Forward slash (/).

questions.questionText: The DOCTYPE declaration must appear:
options: At the end of the document
First, before any other HTML code
questions.correctAnswer: First, before any other HTML code
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) First, before any other HTML code.

questions.questionText: The purpose of DOCTYPE is to:
options: Inform the browser of the HTML version of the document
questions.correctAnswer: Inform the browser of the HTML version of the document
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Inform the browser of the HTML version of the document.

questions.questionText: Which is the correct HTML5 DOCTYPE?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) <!DOCTYPE html>.

questions.questionText: The HTML5 DOCTYPE is compatible with:
options: Older browsers and future versions of HTML
questions.correctAnswer: Older browsers and future versions of HTML
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Older browsers and future versions of HTML.

questions.questionText: HTML is described as:
options: Both a structural and presentational markup language
questions.correctAnswer: Both a structural and presentational markup language
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Both a structural and presentational markup language.

questions.questionText: Structural markup specifies:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) The structure of the content.

questions.questionText: An HTML page is saved with which extension?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) .html.

questions.questionText: The root element of an HTML document is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) <html>.

questions.questionText: The HEAD element contains information that is:
options: Not displayed on the Web page
questions.correctAnswer: Not displayed on the Web page
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Not displayed on the Web page.

questions.questionText: Keywords in a Web page are used by:
options: Search engines to identify the page
questions.correctAnswer: Search engines to identify the page
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Search engines to identify the page.

questions.questionText: The TITLE element specifies the title that appears in the:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Browser title bar or tab.

questions.questionText: The <meta> tag is used to display:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Information about the data (metadata).

questions.questionText: In HTML5, the charset can be specified using:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) <meta charset="UTF-8">.

questions.questionText: UTF-8 is:
options: A commonly used character encoding supporting many alphabets
questions.correctAnswer: A commonly used character encoding supporting many alphabets
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) A commonly used character encoding supporting many alphabets.

questions.questionText: In HTML5, is it mandatory to self-close tags with a slash?
options: No, it is not very important
questions.correctAnswer: No, it is not very important
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) No, it is not very important.

questions.questionText: The <link> tag is used to:
options: Define the association between a document and an external resource
questions.correctAnswer: Define the association between a document and an external resource
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Define the association between a document and an external resource.

questions.questionText: In HTML5, the type attribute is not needed in <link> because:
options: CSS is the default style language
questions.correctAnswer: CSS is the default style language
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) CSS is the default style language.

questions.questionText: In HTML5, the type attribute can be omitted from <script> because:
options: JavaScript is the default scripting language
questions.correctAnswer: JavaScript is the default scripting language
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) JavaScript is the default scripting language.

questions.questionText: The BODY element is used to:
options: Add content visible on the Web page
questions.correctAnswer: Add content visible on the Web page
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Add content visible on the Web page.

questions.questionText: A data type in HTML specifies:
options: The type of value assigned to attributes and content displayed
questions.correctAnswer: The type of value assigned to attributes and content displayed
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) The type of value assigned to attributes and content displayed.

questions.questionText: Which data type specifies the color to be applied to content?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Color.

questions.questionText: Length values in HTML can be specified in:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Pixels or as a percentage.

questions.questionText: A pixel refers to:
options: The smallest dot on the screen
questions.correctAnswer: The smallest dot on the screen
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) The smallest dot on the screen.

questions.questionText: Which is an example of a content type (MIME type) for a video file?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) video/mpg.

questions.questionText: Which global attribute specifies the direction of text?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) dir.

questions.questionText: Which global attribute specifies the context menu for an element?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) contextmenu.

questions.questionText: The draggable attribute specifies:
options: Whether an element can be dragged
questions.correctAnswer: Whether an element can be dragged
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Whether an element can be dragged.

questions.questionText: The dropzone attribute specifies:
options: Whether dragged data is copied, moved, or linked when dropped
questions.correctAnswer: Whether dragged data is copied, moved, or linked when dropped
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Whether dragged data is copied, moved, or linked when dropped.

questions.questionText: HTML entities are:
options: Special reserved characters displayed using codes
questions.correctAnswer: Special reserved characters displayed using codes
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Special reserved characters displayed using codes.

questions.questionText: Entities in HTML begin with ______ and end with ______.
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) & and ;.

questions.questionText: Which entity represents the less-than sign (<)?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) <.

questions.questionText: Which entity represents a non-breaking space?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B)  .

questions.questionText: Which entity displays the ampersand character?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) &.

questions.questionText: Which entity displays the copyright symbol?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) ©.

questions.questionText: Based on end tag usage, HTML tags are classified as:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Container and standalone.

questions.questionText: A container element includes:
options: Start tag, contents, sub-elements, and end tag
questions.correctAnswer: Start tag, contents, sub-elements, and end tag
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Start tag, contents, sub-elements, and end tag.

questions.questionText: A standalone element consists of:
options: Start tag and attributes ending with />
Start and end tags with content
questions.correctAnswer: Start tag and attributes ending with />
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Start tag and attributes ending with />.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a standalone tag?
questions.explanation:
Correct answer is D)
.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a container tag?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) <title>.

questions.questionText: HTML5 is not supported by:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Older mobile devices.

questions.questionText: HTML5 helps mobile development by offering:
options: Drag-and-drop, video embedding, and offline capabilities
questions.correctAnswer: Drag-and-drop, video embedding, and offline capabilities
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Drag-and-drop, video embedding, and offline capabilities.

questions.questionText: By using HTML5, development cost for different operating systems can be saved by up to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) 30%.

questions.questionText: Which is a benefit of HTML5 for mobile development?
options: It is compatible with most operating system platforms
questions.correctAnswer: It is compatible with most operating system platforms
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) It is compatible with most operating system platforms.

questions.questionText: In HTML5, media functions such as audio and video:
options: Have improved support without third-party programs
questions.correctAnswer: Have improved support without third-party programs
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Have improved support without third-party programs.

questions.questionText: Location-based and map applications in HTML5:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Have greater support.
